caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four turned legs, each leg being dark brown in color with rounded, segmented features. The tabletop is a medium brown with visible grain texture, and the apron beneath the tabletop is decorated with a series of muted red, green, and gold painted designs, including geometric shapes and stylized floral or foliate motifs. The central section of the apron features an arched detail with a scalloped edge, painted in a reddish hue and bordered with gold accents. The drawing is composed on an off-white background, with a faint rectangular border indicating the bounds of the drawing area. In the lower right corner, the name "Elizabeth Curtis" is inscribed in small, neat handwriting. There are no other objects or background details depicted.
title: Bench
